### New Relic Chooses Aviso AI for Accurate Forecasting of its Consumption-based Revenue

New Relic selected Aviso for its AI-powered revenue and consumption forecasting capabilities to make the business model be more customer centric to drive more value, as opposed to other vendors like Clari and Anaplan, whose out of the box AI ML were just not capable enough to deliver to their requirements.

[Read Case Study](https://www.aviso.com/case-study/datastax)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/YF6fSuEj0EzvuZINv6hgZn1eY.png?width=350&height=110)

### DataStax Reduced Its Technology Stack By Choosing Aviso’s Integrated RevOps Platform

Aviso provided DataStax with a single pane of glass RevOps and intelligence platform with adjacent capabilities for growing expansion needs and worked as an always-on success partner to get smarter on the technology.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/b56X6F3UMyO8beH9mj7evLPQ.png?width=173&height=50)

[Read Case Study](https://www.aviso.com/case-study/mural)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/5B1XSeRY6REPARKXqFr32GIQ9T8.png?width=449&height=393)
